identification: Watercolour/gouache of an Alpine summit cross (Gipfelkreuz), a timber cross braced with wire stays on a snowy rock summit, Dolomite/Tyrol-style peaks behind, warm evening sky. Crisp, opaque handling suggests gouache-heightened watercolour, probably Austrian/German/Swiss mid-20th-century, likely tourist or amateur work. Black mount, white modern box frame. 28 x 22 cm.
